تستنسبوا (form X)
# تَسْتَنْسِبُوا (tastansibū) /tas.tan.si.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَبَ (istansaba)
# تُسْتَنْسَبُوا (tustansabū) /tus.tan.sa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَنْسَبَ (istansaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
